title: Vegan Lasagne
subtitle: Lentil bolognese with cashew bechamel
excerpt: A fully plant-based lasagne that delivers the same layered, saucy satisfaction as the original. A rich lentil and vegetable bolognese sits between layers of pasta and a cashew-based white sauce that sets firm and creamy as it bakes.

recipe.sourceNotes: This is a plant-based version of the classic baked Italian lasagne. Lentils provide the body and umami depth that minced meat contributes in the original. Cashew bechamel is a widely used technique in plant-based cooking: raw cashews soaked and blended with water, nutritional yeast, and seasoning give a white sauce that bakes to a satisfying, creamy layer.

recipeTools.notes: Deep 30 x 20 cm dish for baking.

content.text: Soak the cashews in water for at least 4 hours or overnight before blending; this is what gives the bechamel a smooth, creamy consistency. The lentil bolognese is improved by a long cook and a generous pour of red wine: let it reduce properly so the sauce is thick and concentrated rather than watery. Layer generously: each pasta layer should have a good covering of both sauces.

items.preparation: soaked in cold water for 4 hours, drained

content.text: Cook the lentils in unsalted water for 25 minutes until just tender. Drain and set aside.

Heat the olive oil in a large pan. Cook the onion, carrot, and celery for 10 minutes. Add the garlic and mushrooms and cook for 5 more minutes until the mushrooms have released their water. Add the tomato puree and stir for 1 minute. Add the red wine and let it reduce by half. Add the tinned tomatoes and drained lentils. Season and simmer for 25 minutes until thick.

Make the bechamel: blend the soaked, drained cashews with 400 ml water, the nutritional yeast, garlic powder, 1 tsp salt, and pepper until completely smooth. The mixture should pour easily; add more water if too thick.

Heat the oven to 190 C / fan 170 C / gas 5. Assemble in a deep 30 x 20 cm baking dish: spread a thin layer of bolognese on the base, then a layer of lasagne sheets, then bolognese, then a layer of cashew bechamel. Repeat twice more, finishing with a generous layer of bechamel on top. Cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake for 15 more minutes until the top is golden.
